def cksum(buf, s1=0, s2=0):
    if len(buf) % 8: buf += b'\x00'*(8-len(buf)%8)
    for i in range(0, len(buf), 8):
        a, b = struct.unpack('<II', buf[i:i+8])
        s1 = (s1 + a + s2) & 0xffffffff
        s2 = (s2 + b + s1) & 0xffffffff
    return s1, s2

magic, ver, page_size = 0x377f0682, 3007000, PS
salt1, salt2 = 0x11223344, 0x55667788
hdr = struct.pack('>IIII', magic, ver, page_size, 1) + struct.pack('>II', salt1, salt2)
c1, c2 = cksum(hdr[:24])
wal = hdr + struct.pack('>II', c1, c2)
cks = (c1, c2)

    fh = struct.pack('>II', i, dbpages) + struct.pack('>II', salt1, salt2)

    s1, s2 = cksum(page, s1, s2)
    cks = (s1, s2)
